# Sela Reader 1.5

Two products: Reader is a private installable web app on desktop, tablet and phone. Viewer is a lightweight CDN/ESM plugin for websites/frameworks, inline or fullscreen. Browser-extension distribution is discontinued.

Reader has Home, Shelf, Explore and Settings; local IndexedDB books, collections, favorites, sorting, format/status filters, grid/list views and full ZIP backup. Bottom navigation on phones, side rail on wide screens. Theme/language in Settings; appearance also switches directly in the reader. Reader and Viewer use one responsive interface. Cloud backup is manual export/share/upload and restore. Optional Google Drive/OneDrive imports need your own OAuth registration and consent; no automatic account sync. Explore searches Open Library and Gutenberg catalogs. Sample books are saved explicitly; originals should be retained because browser storage can be evicted.

PDF (lazy PDF.js), EPUB, CBZ, TXT/MD/sanitized HTML/text FB2. Optional external GPL DjVu decoder; CBR/MOBI/AZW/DOCX/DRM unsupported. Search, embedded outlines, browser TTS, notes, filters/brightness/dim; no PDF aligned text layer, EPUB CFI or OCR. Browser/OS voices vary; no voice-service key required.

Main Viewer entry ~26.2 KiB gzip, excluding decoder, document and optional modules. No Bootstrap/jQuery or UI framework dependency. Web app installation depends on browser capabilities. Old browsers receive original PDF links; iPhone 4 cannot run the full offline app. Physical device validation remains outstanding.
